div.style: color: rgb(1, 87, 155) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Raw Audio Stream
4.0s @ 16 kHz Mono (64,000 samples)

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Sliding Window Slicer
Window = 4.0s | Stride = 2.0s

div.style: color: rgb(27, 94, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT)
N_fft = 1024 (64ms) | Hop = 512 (32ms) | Hann Window

div.style: color: rgb(27, 94, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
128-Band Mel Filterbank & Log dB
0 Hz - 8,000 Hz → Log Decibel Compression: 10*log10(S/1.0)

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Log-Mel Spectrogram Matrix
Shape: (128 Mel bands × 126 Time frames) = 16,128 features

div.style: color: rgb(255, 111, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
SpecAugment (On-the-Fly)
Time Masking (t≤15) + Freq Masking (f≤15) + Gaussian Jitter N(0, 0.05)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 111, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Z-Score Standardization
x_norm = (x - mean) / std across all 16,128 features

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Reshape Layer
Input (16128,) → (126 Time × 128 Freq × 1 Channel)

div.style: color: rgb(49, 27, 146) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Conv Block 1
Conv2D(8 filters, 3x3) + BatchNorm + MaxPool(2x2) → (63, 64, 8)

div.style: color: rgb(49, 27, 146) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Conv Block 2
Conv2D(16 filters, 3x3) + BatchNorm + MaxPool(2x2) → (31, 32, 16)

div.style: color: rgb(49, 27, 146) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Dual 1D Temporal Pooling (The Core Innovation)
Reshape to (31, 512) → Concatenate[GlobalMax1D ⊕ GlobalAvg1D] → (1024,)
Simultaneously captures explosive blast peak and reverberant decay

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Classification Head
Dense(32, ReLU) + Dropout(0.3) → Dense(1, Sigmoid)

div.style: color: rgb(136, 14, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Full-Integer INT8 Quantizer
Calibrated with 200 representative samples
Weights & Activations mapped from float32 to int8 [-128, 127]

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
gunshot_detector.tflite (44.0 KB)
15.9x compression | Zero floating-point operations

div.style: color: rgb(0, 77, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
RMS Wake-Up Filter
RMS > 0.015 over 100ms window
(Keeps chip asleep during ambient quiet)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 77, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
On-Device TFLite Invocation
Execution latency: ~35-45ms
